name: Entity Link Display
description: Adds a computed 'Display Link' link base field to every entity type with a canonical template, plus a 'Display Link' field formatter that renders a configurable link to the entity's canonical page.
project_description:
Entity Link Display provides a simple, reusable field formatter that renders a link to the current entity’s canonical URL. This allows site builders to add direct "view" links for content entities (nodes, users, taxonomy terms, etc.) directly in display modes, view modes, or Layout Builder without writing any custom code or overriding templates.

It’s particularly useful when building admin dashboards, reports, or content listings where a quick link to the full entity page is needed. Unlike traditional approaches where you might need to override templates or write custom Twig for teasers, view modes, or Layout Builder displays, this module works out of the box — just like the "Link to content" field in Views.

The module requires no modules outside Drupal core. On enable it attaches a computed 'Display Link' base field (hidden by default) to every entity type that has a canonical link template, and registers the 'Display Link' formatter (id entity_link_display) for link fields. To use it, open Manage Display for a bundle/view mode, move 'Display Link' out of the disabled region, and configure the link text, CSS class, rel attributes and target.
